propositions: A new generator script must produce two standalone documentation files (config-reference.md and security.md) from registry sources while leaving docs/config.md unchanged to preserve existing consumer tests and anchor links.

The generator must derive configuration lifecycle/deprecation information from rebar._deprecations.REGISTRY filtered by kind==cfg and render it alongside schema and secret-name inventory into registry-derived tables plus curated narrative sections.
Both generated docs must carry a top-of-file banner naming the generating command and be registered in test_generated_surface_markers.py and docs/README.md table, enforced by a parity gate test.
A --check drift mode must detect staleness of either generated doc with newline normalization to handle CRLF checkouts, gated by tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py under make test.

A topic-coverage test must verify that across both generated docs, anchors exist for all required topics: precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, and MCP/CLI exposure.
